what: CPU inference latency of the exported ONNX graph, EfficientNet-B0 at 224px
why: NFR2 requires CPU inference at or under 500 ms per image. The service classifies a whole 5x5 patch lattice for one photograph in a single call, so the per-image figure is that call.
caveat: The weights come from a synthetic pipeline-verification run, so this says nothing about accuracy. Latency depends on the architecture, the input size and the runtime — not on what the weights learned — so it IS valid evidence for the architecture choice.
